description: This file contains implementations of exponential and logarithmic functions for rational numbers, including Taylor series approximations, power calculations, and scaling techniques, within a rational number library.

methods.name: _exprat
methods.description: Calculates the exponential of a rational number using Taylor series approximation.

methods.name: exprat
methods.description: Calculates the exponential of a rational number, handling large values and integer powers.

methods.name: __lograt
methods.description: Private implementation of logarithm using Taylor series, scaled between 1 and e^0.5.

methods.name: _lograt
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of a rational number with scaling and Taylor series.

methods.name: lograt
methods.description: Public function to compute the natural logarithm of a rational number.

methods.name: log10rat
methods.description: Computes the base-10 logarithm of a rational number.

methods.name: IsEven
methods.description: Determines if a rational number (with denominator 1) is even based on its numerator.

methods.name: powrat
methods.description: Calculates the power of a rational number raised to another rational exponent, handling special cases.

methods.name: powratNumeratorDenominator
methods.description: Calculates power when exponent is a fraction, using numerator and denominator separately.

methods.name: powratcomp
methods.description: Core function to compute x^y using exponential and logarithm, handling zero, one, and fractional exponents.
